transcript.text: Alright everyone, before I can sign off on the 'Midnight Arcade' delivery package, I need to run through the package-lock routine. I need signoff from rights, post-production, and publicity on the current draft — which lists worldwide delivery, our standard music credit, a 4K UHD 24fps master, English subtitles, and a June 14 publicity release date. Please each report any required changes from your departments so I can review and give final approval.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Mara, from the rights department, I need to flag two required changes to the current draft package. First, the delivery territory cannot be listed as worldwide — based on the music license terms I reviewed this morning, distribution is restricted to the United States and Canada only. Second, the music credit needs to be updated from our standard credit to a specific required credit. I have the exact details and can share them now if you'd like to capture them in the package-lock.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag required changes from post-production. I received the broadcaster's completed ingest test today and confirmed that delivery must be an IMF package at 25 fps with English SDH captions. The draft 4K UHD 24 fps master and ordinary English subtitle file in the current package will fail the partner's ingest specification. I've kept the test result in the post-production test folder pending this routine package-lock meeting.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Mara, from publicity I need to flag a required change. I confirmed with the artist's representative this afternoon that publicity for 'Midnight Arcade' is embargoed until June 21. The representative will reject any public release dated earlier than June 21, so the June 14 publicity release date in the current draft must be changed to June 21 or later. I should also note that the approval email documenting this is currently attached to the publicity calendar rather than the delivery tracker, so it may not be visible to everyone in the usual place.
transcript.speaker: A4
